newsitem.title: CHINA: China Communist Party halts unruly flag output.
newsitem.headline: China Communist Party halts unruly flag output.

text.p: China's ruling Communist Party is to ban the unauthorised production of its scarlet flag emblazoned with a golden hammer and sickle after July 1 when only six factories nationwide will have that right.

Factories throughout China produce the party flag and its emblem without authorisation, resulting in sub-standard copies, an official of the Organisation Department of the party Central Committee said on Friday.

"Production of the party flag and emblem is a very serious matter," the Legal Daily said. China's Communist Party has 56 million members and use of the flag and emblem is widespread since virtually every government office and state factory is party-affiliated.
The party would not change the design but would standardise colour and dimensions, the official said.
Only six approved factories could make party flags and emblems from July 1 and those produced by unauthorised factories would be banned from use, he said.
The party flag and emblem must not be used in a trademark or in advertisements, he said.
